experiments.name: Collection allocation by replay sampling factorial
Prospective one-shot selector validation
experiments.candidate_scope: Five standard fixed allocations and one public-diagnostic-derived top-two-failure allocation per context
experiments.top_two_failure_counts: 3 episodes each for the two worst tasks; 1 each for the other two, ties use fixed task order
experiments.selector_freeze: Features, model, tuning and baseline rules must be fixed before any seed 21-23 branch outcome is inspected
experiments.operational_scope: One selection before the 40k continuation; does not establish online adaptive scheduling

phase_gates.E0: A fresh-bank disagreement triggers reporting and measurement diagnosis, not removal of runs or relabeling old Failure choices.
phase_gates.E1: Do not claim an adaptive selector is needed unless repeatable context-dependent opportunity remains after global fixed and time-only fixed schedules.
phase_gates.E2: Interpret donor swaps as resource-substitution effects; target collection is fixed but its on-policy trajectories are not.
phase_gates.E3: Never select or drop task suites because an allocation effect is convenient. If public pretraining diagnostics show a floor or ceiling, report all seeds and formulate a separate pretraining-budget study.
phase_gates.E4: Proceed only with frozen low-capacity rules and genuinely unseen original seeds. A result that favors a simple baseline is accepted.

cost_reference.time_model: Observed pretraining seconds/step and branch seconds/step; remaining replication wall time divided by evaluation episodes is only a planning proxy including I/O and overhead.
